title: Winter sun from Bristol in February: direct flights compared
author: Brogan
intro: February is the month most of us need sun the most, and Bristol has more winter sun routes than you might think. Here's where you can fly direct in February, how long it takes and how warm each place is, so you can pick the right one for your week away.
seo_title: Winter sun from Bristol in February: 2½ to 6 hrs away
seo_description: The Canaries are about 4 hours from Bristol and 21-22°C in February. Egypt and Cape Verde are warmer but further. Every direct option compared.

sections.heading: The short answer
sections.text:
- **Warm and close:** the Canaries, about 4 hrs
- **Warmest:** Cape Verde, about 25°C
- **Shortest flight:** Málaga or Faro
- **Half term:** 15 to 19 February 2027

The temperatures here are average daytime highs for February, from the climate figures in our guides. Flight times are typical direct times from Bristol. We checked routes in November 2026, but airlines change their timetables often, so check the airline's own schedule for your dates before you book.

Morocco is normally an hour ahead of the UK, but it puts its clocks back for Ramadan, which is expected to start in early February 2027. So for most of February it's likely to be on UK time.

For most people it comes down to three choices: the Canaries for an easy week with no jet lag, the Red Sea for guaranteed warmth and reefs, or Cape Verde for proper heat.

sections.heading: The Canaries: the easy choice
sections.text:
The Canary Islands are Bristol's main winter sun routes, with easyJet, TUI and Jet2 between them. February is one of the best months there, at about 21 to 22°C by day, and the islands are on UK time, so there's no jet lag even for a short trip.

- **Tenerife and Gran Canaria** have the most to do. Stay in the south of either island for the most sunshine.
- **Lanzarote** is calmer, with volcanic scenery and low white villages.
- **Fuerteventura** has the longest, emptiest beaches, but it's often windy.

February is carnival month too, and Santa Cruz de Tenerife and Las Palmas on Gran Canaria hold two of the biggest in Europe. Our [Gran Canaria or Tenerife](/blog/gran-canaria-or-tenerife) and [Lanzarote or Fuerteventura](/blog/lanzarote-or-fuerteventura) posts help you choose, and [is Tenerife warm in February?](/blog/is-tenerife-warm-in-february) goes into the weather in more detail.

sections.heading: Shorter flights: Málaga, Faro, Madeira and Morocco
sections.text:
If four hours feels too long, or you only have a few days, these are closer or quieter:

- **Málaga and Faro:** about two and a half hours, and both run all year. At around 17 to 18°C they're mild rather than hot, but often sunny enough for lunch outside. Our [Seville or Málaga in winter](/blog/seville-or-malaga-in-winter) post compares two Andalusian cities.
- **[Madeira](/destinations/madeira):** a little cooler than the Canaries at about 19°C, but February is when its gardens start to flower and it's a lovely time to walk the levada paths. easyJet and Jet2 are the airlines listed on the route.
- **[Marrakech](/destinations/marrakech):** about three and a half hours and around 20°C by day. easyJet is listed on the route, and Ryanair has flown it too.
- **[Agadir](/destinations/agadir):** Morocco's beach option, with a long sandy bay and about 21°C. easyJet is listed as flying there all year.

Watch out: Marrakech can drop to single figures after dark in February, so pack a warm layer for evenings on the rooftops.

sections.heading: The Red Sea and Cape Verde: guaranteed warmth
sections.text:
If you want to be sure of beach weather, go further south:

- **[Hurghada](/destinations/hurghada) and [Sharm el-Sheikh](/destinations/sharm-el-sheikh):** about 22 to 23°C, with sunshine nearly every day and coral reefs just offshore. easyJet and TUI both fly to Egypt from Bristol. The flight is about five and a half hours, and Egypt is two hours ahead.
- **[Cape Verde](/destinations/cape-verde):** about 25°C on Sal, with long white beaches and steady trade winds. easyJet started flying from Bristol to Sal in May 2026, three times a week, and TUI has flown there too. It's about six hours, and Cape Verde is an hour behind the UK.

UK visitors need a visa for Egypt, which can usually be bought on arrival. Check GOV.UK's travel advice for each country before you book, as entry rules can change.

sections.heading: February half term from Bristol
sections.text:
Bristol City Council's schools have February half term from 15 to 19 February 2027. Academies can set their own dates, and schools in North Somerset, South Gloucestershire and Bath may differ slightly, so check with your school.

- **For the best prices:** go in the first two weeks of February or the week after half term.
- **For a short break:** Málaga, Faro or Marrakech work well for three or four nights.
- **For a week of guaranteed warmth:** the Red Sea or Cape Verde.
- **For snow instead:** easyJet flies to Geneva, and Jet2 has added Chambéry, Geneva and Innsbruck for the ski season.

Tip: half term week is the busiest of the winter at Bristol, with the early-morning flights all leaving at once. See [how early to arrive at Bristol Airport](/blog/how-early-should-you-arrive-at-bristol-airport), and book parking ahead.

Our [February half term](/destinations/february-half-term-holidays) page has more ideas, and [where to go in February](/destinations/where-to-go-in-february) covers the whole month.

sections.heading: Where could you go from Bristol?
sections.text:
Start with [Tenerife](/destinations/tenerife) or [Lanzarote](/destinations/lanzarote) for an easy week, or [Hurghada](/destinations/hurghada) if you want real warmth. Our guide to [where you can fly direct from Bristol](/blog/where-can-you-fly-direct-from-bristol-airport) lists the full route map, including city breaks and skiing.

Can't agree between the islands and the Red Sea? Add your favourites to somewhere.party, give everyone points to vote with, and let the draw choose.

faqs.question: Where is warmest in February with a direct flight from Bristol?
faqs.answer: Cape Verde is the warmest, at about 25°C on Sal, followed by Sharm el-Sheikh and Hurghada on the Red Sea at about 22 to 23°C. The Canaries are close behind at 21 to 22°C, with a shorter flight and no time difference.

faqs.question: How long is the flight from Bristol to Tenerife?
faqs.answer: About four and a quarter hours direct. Lanzarote and Fuerteventura are a little shorter at about four hours.

faqs.question: When is February half term 2027 in Bristol?
faqs.answer: Bristol City Council schools break up for half term from 15 to 19 February 2027. Academies and schools in neighbouring council areas can set different dates, so check with your school.

faqs.question: Is Málaga warm enough in February?
faqs.answer: Málaga is mild rather than hot, at about 18°C by day in February. It's good for a sunny city break and lunch outside, but too cool for most people to sunbathe or swim.
